title: At lunch
offscreen: Play 'school lunch' at home: a tray, a queue, and a seat at the table chosen by the child.

scenes.text: At lunch there's something you've never eaten.

options.label: I taste a tiny bit
options.outcome: It's not bad! You don't finish it, but you tried.

options.label: I say no thank you
options.outcome: That's fine. The teacher gives you some bread. Maybe you'll taste it tomorrow.

options.label: I ask what it is
options.outcome: It's pumpkin. The teacher says it tastes a bit like potato.

scenes.text: You knock your glass of water over on the table.

options.label: I call the teacher
options.outcome: The teacher brings a cloth. You wipe it up together.

options.label: I feel like crying
options.outcome: It happens. The child next to you helps you move your plate.

options.label: I get the napkins
options.outcome: You wipe up a bit yourself, then the teacher arrives with a cloth.

intro.bo: Shall we try together, {nome}? If we get it wrong, we'll try again.
intro.pilu: Look carefully, {nome}. Then tell me what you think.
intro.tango: Come on, {nome}, let's do it! Slowly though... all right, slowly.

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. I got a bit scared, but it worked out.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}, you looked carefully. That's enough for today.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, tomorrow we'll do another one. Now I'm off running.
